class.name: ModelData
class.description: A building, any 3D object: which model and whose (the backend that finds it by its name), with which skins, where it stands and from how far it is seen; drawn through [ModelRenderingServer]. A scenery holds them ([member CompiledScenery.models]).

method.name: translated
method.description: A copy of the model placed [param offset] further.

members.member: Its lights' colours, by name: [code]{light: Color}[/code] ([method ModelRenderingServer.instance_set_lights_colors]).
Its lights on or off, by name: [code]{light: bool}[/code] ([method ModelRenderingServer.instance_set_lights_state]); a light not named is as the model has it.
The model's name; the backend of [member rendering_backend] finds its file.
The name of the model renderer's backend the model is the one of ([ModelRenderingServer]); empty for the default one.
The placement's name - the resource's own ([member Resource.resource_name]) - empty for none; a signal head is registered under it.
Visible up to this distance, 0 - no limit.
Euler angles (radians), same order as [member Node3D.rotation].
Set when the model is a signal head.
